name: Order of the Golden String
rules: STARTING RESOURCES -- 1 Greed, 1 staple resource -- STARTING DRAW -- 8 going first, 9 going second -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn, draw a card or play a resource. -- DRAW -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- RESOURCE -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Play a resource. -- CONSPIRE -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Draw 2 cards. Discard a card.
notes: Faction card; no type bar, no artist credit and no collector number printed (footer says only STAPLE). Header reads INFLUENCE – 20.

name: A Blazing Zero
subtitle: the collision of magic and antimagic
rules: If you deployed this card in response to a tactic, terminate that tactic. Put that tactic into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.
flavor:
"Battles raged long before war came to Marduun, but when war came, the sky stayed lit for half a century with brilliant blazes of might and destruction."
— Marduun, a Forgotten History authored by the Right Honorable Basel E. Corgington, Esq
printing: original Open R&D card name by jedibcg
notes: Footer also credits: original Open R&D card name by jedibcg.

name: Adriel, Defender of Marduun
subtitle: ultimately, he didn't do a great job
typeLine: WARLORD CHARACTER – adriel, sword of great justice
rules: UNIQUE ADRIEL -- When battle damage is inflicted to this card while it's blocking, reduce the amount to 0.
flavor: He really tried though, bless his heart.

name: Treachery
rules: This card provides – [D][D] -- When this card enters play, your faction loses 1 influence.
notes: Horizontal (landscape) card. Provides line is printed before the enters-play sentence; catalog has them in the other order.

name: Legions of Chaos
rules: STARTING RESOURCES – Any 2 staple resources. -- STARTING DRAW – 8 going first, 9 going second. -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn, draw a card or play a resource. -- DRAW -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- RESOURCE -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Play a resource. -- When a character enters play under your control, you may pay 3. If you do, search your deck for a character that does not share a trade with any characters you control, reveal it and put it into your hand.
notes: Faction card; no type bar. Header reads INFLUENCE – 21. Footer says STAPLE 5/8.
